assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary and key-area polygons are repository-provided provisional constraints derived from official announcement text and area values. They are not official redlines and are used only for generation, visualization, intake self-check, and design discussion.
assumptions.impact: All areas, ratios, and spatial positions must be recalculated when official polygons are released; no precise area or statutory claim is made from provisional geometry.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The railway heritage park spine, greenways, and scenario axes are schematic design concepts based on the provisional boundary and public description of the Jing-Zhang railway corridor. Their exact alignment is not claimed.
assumptions.impact: Corridor positions in figures and layers are illustrative; official rail, park, and blue-line geometry is required before deepening.

assumptions.statement: The road centerline network in geometry/roads.geojson is a schematic grid for design discussion of microcirculation and slow-mobility organization, not road redlines.
assumptions.impact: Road widths, alignments, and densities are concept values and must be verified against official transport plans.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints in geometry/buildings.geojson are abstract design-proposal masses illustrating renewal and buildable logic, not approved buildings or site plans.
assumptions.impact: Floor area, heights, and densities are not claimed; FAR and height controls are pending official conditions.

assumptions.statement: No population, employment, or per-capita service ratios are asserted because official population and employment data for the provisional boundary are not available.
assumptions.impact: Per-capita metrics are intentionally omitted to avoid fabricated certainty.

assumptions.statement: All AI scenario cards, test/validation scenarios, landmarks, events, and operation mechanisms are concept proposals or reference schemes for professional teams to deepen.
assumptions.impact: Nothing in this proposal is stated as an approved government action, confirmed investment, or guaranteed implementation.
